messages:
Aisha K.: Pavo wants a short POC for a finetuned Llama30b variant (entity extraction). Start hosted, may move to Dedicated for SLA. Need quick compatibility + pricing. cc @Tom L., @Riley M.

Tom L.: Questions: custom tokenizer? PHI that forces Private? expected sustained qps / peak?

Aisha K.: Tokenizer: standard llama-tokenizer. There will be PHI in some tests; early POC can be hosted with obfuscation. Baseline 25 qps, bursts to 150 (30s). Target p50 <400ms.

Riley M.: 25 qps on Llama30b hosted doable with batching, p50 400ms is tight. Need avg/max seq len and KV-cache reuse. Also quantization target (int8/int4)?

Aisha K.: Avg seq ~120, max ~1024. High KV reuse. Prefer int8, int4 acceptable if quality ok.

Jordan S.: Compatibility checklist: tokenizer ok; verify HF-style weights and attention layer names; check KV-cache shapes; run int8 eval sweep. Deployment path: hosted -> dedicated -> private (if KMS needed).

Jordan S.: Run when manifest uploaded:
redwood-cli model inspect --manifest s3://pavo-artifacts/llama30b-ft/manifest.json
redwood-ops run-compatibility --model-id pavo-llama30b-ft --checks kv-layout,attention-names,tokenizer

Tom L.: Pricing sketch: hosted int8 placeholder $0.0009/1k tokens unit; will refine after avg output tokens. Rough POC monthly ~ $18k + $2k support (placeholder).

Riley M.: Ops notes: warm KV-cache lowers p50 significantly; recommend warmup endpoint. int4 may introduce regressions—tie to evals.

Aisha K.: I'll request sample traffic and 15 eval prompts; they sent security questionnaire too.

legal-bot: Use internal SQ template. Reusable answers: KMS supported (AWS KMS/customer-managed), retention configurable, model provenance logged. Draft will be uploaded.

Jordan S.: If loader sees attention-name mismatch we can shim it. Will provide warmup curl example.

Tom L.: After sample tokens, updated POC hosted int8 estimate $14k/mo. If SLA requires <400ms p50 under burst, recommend Dedicated reserve ~$28k/mo + setup.

Aisha K.: Uploaded manifest + evals to s3://pavo-poc/2026-03-evals and SQ PDF. Scheduling call with Jordan + Tom 10am PT tomorrow.

Riley M.: Running int8 sweep now. Early: p50 ~380ms at 25qps with batching; p95 ~1.1s cold. Warmup should help.

Jordan S.: Compatibility job passed with minor kv-shape mismatch shimmed. Job link internal.

legal-bot: Draft SQ answers uploaded internally.

Aisha K.: Thanks team—I'll confirm next steps after call.
